statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one CVE whose vendorProject is Fortinet or Schneider Electric, with dateAdded between 2026-08-12 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed holds at least one entry with vendorProject Fortinet or Schneider Electric and a dateAdded value between 2026-08-12 and 2026-10-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry from either vendor carries a dateAdded value inside the window.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds at least one new Microsoft SharePoint Server CVE, with dateAdded between 2026-08-12 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: TRUE if a KEV entry whose product field names SharePoint carries a dateAdded between 2026-08-12 and 2026-10-16 inclusive and was absent from the catalog on 2026-08-11.
failure_condition: The KEV catalog gains no SharePoint entry with a dateAdded inside the window.

statement: The US Treasury designates at least one person or entity for facilitating North Korean arms or missile transfers to Russia, with the action dated between 2026-08-12 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if an OFAC press release or SDN list update dated inside the window names DPRK-to-Russia arms, missile, or munitions transfer as a basis for the designation.
failure_condition: No OFAC action inside the window cites DPRK-to-Russia arms or missile transfer as a designation basis.

statement: United States and Iranian officials hold a publicly acknowledged direct bilateral meeting between 2026-08-12 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if a US executive branch statement and an Iranian foreign ministry statement both confirm a direct bilateral meeting held inside the window, and two of Reuters, AP, AFP report it.
failure_condition: No direct US-Iran bilateral meeting held inside the window is confirmed by both governments.

statement: NYMEX front-month WTI crude futures settle at or above 95.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-12 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the CME published settlement price for the front-month WTI contract is 95.00 or higher on any trading day between 2026-08-12 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: Every front-month WTI settlement inside the window prints below 95.00 dollars.

statement: The New York Fed Household Debt and Credit Report for Q3 2026 reports aggregate credit card balances above 1.26 trillion US dollars.
resolution: TRUE if the Q3 2026 report published on newyorkfed.org states an aggregate credit card balance greater than 1.26 trillion dollars, published on or before the deadline.
failure_condition: The Q3 2026 report shows credit card balances at or below 1.26 trillion dollars, or no such report exists by the deadline.

statement: A US federal court enters an order blocking enforcement of the administration policy limiting birthright citizenship, with the order dated between 2026-08-12 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if a public federal court docket shows an injunction, temporary restraining order, class-wide relief, or vacatur against the birthright citizenship policy entered inside the window.
failure_condition: No federal court order entered inside the window restrains or vacates the policy.

statement: Thailand adopts a cabinet resolution or statutory amendment permanently tightening civilian firearm permit rules, adopted between 2026-08-12 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if a Thai government announcement plus reporting by two of Reuters, AP, AFP, Bangkok Post confirm a cabinet resolution or Firearms Act amendment adopted inside the window.
failure_condition: No Thai cabinet resolution or statutory amendment tightening firearm permits is adopted inside the window.

statement: The USGS catalog lists at least one magnitude 6.0 or greater earthquake within 300 km of USGS event us6000tjl2, with origin time between 2026-08-12 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the USGS FDSN event query returns at least one M6.0 or greater event within 300 km of the us6000tjl2 epicenter with origin time inside the window.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog holds no M6.0 or greater event meeting both the radius and the origin-time criteria.

statement: CAL FIRE reports the Timber Fire near Big Sur at 100 percent containment, with a containment date between 2026-08-12 and 2026-09-15.
resolution: TRUE if the CAL FIRE incident page for the Timber Fire shows 100 percent containment with a containment date inside the window.
failure_condition: The CAL FIRE incident record shows containment below 100 percent, or a containment date after 2026-09-15.
